import dask,distributed,json
c=dask.config
c.update_defaults({'distributed': {'scheduler': {'worker-ttl':None}, 'comm':{'timeouts':{'connect':'300s','tcp':'300s'}}}})

print(json.dumps({k:c.get(k) for k in ['distributed.comm.timeouts.connect','distributed.comm.timeouts.tcp','distributed.scheduler.worker-ttl']}))
